_comment: This file (ar.py) is a Boost.Build test mock script. It imports from MockProgram and consists solely of command() calls that register expected 'ar' archive invocations for various toolchain/platform combinations, followed by a main() call. It defines no local functions, classes, or CLI entry points. No actionable tool examples are available.
review_ar_mock: review the ar.py mock script that registers expected ar archive commands for boost build toolset testing
summarize_ar_mock: summarize the ar.py test mock file containing ar rsc command registrations for static library linking across platforms
test_ar_mock: test the ar.py mock script to verify ar archive commands are registered correctly for boost build toolset tests
refactor_ar_mock: refactor the ar.py mock script to parameterize toolchain and platform paths instead of hardcoding them
run_ar_mock: run the ar.py mock script to validate ar archive command expectations for boost build static linking tests
